label: D2 after a2 reached S2 (common) following a rewarded trial, mid-episode (trials 10-50)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), only when the observed input is a2 -> S2 via a common transition and the previous trial was rewarded (each condition holds for 100% of activations); also confined to episode trials ~10-55 (zero after trial 60), and only when the model value is high (>8.1) and the policy strongly favors a2. Never fires at D1/GO, on S1, on rare transitions, or after unrewarded trials. The necessary-condition predicate without the ep_trial window has recall 1.0 but precision 0.12; adding the episode window gives recall 0.92, precision ~0.27. Magnitude is largest on the first rewarded-common-S2 trial after a streak begins (e.g. after an unrewarded or rare trial) and decays over consecutive repeats of a2->S2c rewarded (1.0 -> 0.35 -> 0.12); requiring the trial two back to be unrewarded raises precision to 0.40 but captures only 54% of mass. Also biased toward episodes that started with S2 bad (start_high=0). Precision remains incomplete: it is a sparse, magnitude-graded subset of an a2/S2 win-stay context. Uses only observed variables.
